name: Stroking a fed-up Boop calms it; shaking it makes it dizzy; a swipe is a stroke too
judge: Fed up from pokes, Boop gets a stroke, later a shake, later a swipe. Strokes should soothe it; the shake should startle it.
reasonable: Softer at the stroke, grudging, calm or relieved. Baffled, startled or put out at the shake. Softer again at the swipe, even comfy by then. Mood easing overall.
unreasonable: Angrier at the stroke, instantly delighted while still cross, enjoying the shake, or still at full fury after the swipe.
